budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: Successor of r3a/r3b (GPL-0305: routability weighted congestion 3.13, 45 tiny seam fences saturated by inflation). Each seam landing half now sits on the child face its pins use: sq<->vc seams in a band NORTH of u_l1 (was south: two hairpins of 1,296 bits around u_l1), sq<->lk seams south of u_l1, lk band north of u_l0, vc band south of u_l2. One fence per region band (4 bands + 3 reset fences, was 45 boxes), std util < ~10 %. ck_sq/rst_n_sq enter beside the u_l1 centre. Outline enlarged to 518.4 x 1425.6 (both inter-child gaps +43.2 um). No RTL, child view, landing record or timing-limit change.
